# Checklists and to-do lists

<!-- codeforge:local-only:start -->

Section 4 · Functional specifications

Parent page: [Functional specifications](section-4.md)

<!-- codeforge:local-only:end -->

<!-- codeforge:body:start (testo scrivibile: e' la sorgente pubblicata su Confluence) seed:a090faccf58db0fa -->
Checklists cut across device requests and projects. An administrator maintains templates by category; a checklist is instantiated for a request according to its device type, or cloned; items are assigned and progress through statuses; the completeness gate tells a consumer whether the list is ready; and each user sees their assigned items in a single aggregated view. Families and external parties can follow progress through a public read-only link. The flow bound to device requests is described in the discovery context; the corresponding project flow is in the projects area.
<!-- codeforge:body:end -->
